# teams_compliance_recording_policy (Data Source)

Look up an existing ComplianceRecordingPolicy object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `compliance_recording_applications` (String) Maps to the -ComplianceRecordingApplications parameter.
- `custom_banner` (String) Maps to the -CustomBanner parameter.
- `custom_prompts_enabled` (Boolean) Maps to the -CustomPromptsEnabled parameter.
- `custom_prompts_package_id` (String) Maps to the -CustomPromptsPackageId parameter.
- `description` (String) Maps to the -Description parameter.
- `disable_compliance_recording_audio_notification_for_calls` (Boolean) Maps to the -DisableComplianceRecordingAudioNotificationForCalls parameter.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Maps to the -Enabled parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `record_rerouted_calls` (Boolean) Maps to the -RecordReroutedCalls parameter.
- `warn_user_on_removal` (Boolean) Maps to the -WarnUserOnRemoval parameter.
